# references

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:references`](gmeow-references.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/references>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/citations`](../../slices/citations.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A related resource that is referenced, cited, or otherwise pointed to by the described resource. (RFC 5322 References for messages; bibliographic references for creative works.)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the generic, flat-first pointer from one entity to a related resource it points to — a message-thread reference or a bibliographic reference — when the kind, locus, or standpoint of the link need not be typed.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it when the link is specifically a citation with an intent or pinpoint (use [`gmeow:cites`](gmeow-cites.md), or promote to a [`gmeow:CitationAct`](../classes/gmeow-CitationAct.md)) and avoid asserting both directions — state [`gmeow:references`](gmeow-references.md) and read [`gmeow:isReferencedBy`](gmeow-isReferencedBy.md) as its inverse.

### How to use

- Assert one [`gmeow:references`](gmeow-references.md) triple per pointed-to resource (non-functional); promote to the typed citation machinery ([`gmeow:cites`](gmeow-cites.md) / [`gmeow:CitationAct`](../classes/gmeow-CitationAct.md)) when kind, locus, or standpoint matters.

### Examples

- ex:reply [`gmeow:references`](gmeow-references.md) ex:originalMessage.
